title: Docs Program: Model primitive docs refresh across web/examples/books
description:
# Docs Program: Model Primitive (Web + Examples + Books)

We need a coordinated documentation refresh for the Tactus Model primitive across these sibling repos:

- ../Tactus-web
- ../Tactus-examples
- ../Learning-Tactus
- ../Tactus-in-a-Nutshell
- ../Programming-Tactus

Goal: someone can start anywhere (marketing page, examples, tutorial book, quick reference, deep reference) and get the same mental model, same syntax, and the same train/eval/testing workflow.

## Canon (must match everywhere)

- A single Model block contains both runtime config and training config under training = { ... }.
- CLI:
  - Train: tactus train file.tac --model <name>
  - Evaluate: tactus models evaluate file.tac --model <name> [--version ... | --candidate ...]
- Registry tags:
  - latest
  - candidate/<candidate_name>
- Call pattern:
  - local m = Model("name"); local r = m({ ... }); local out = r.output or r
- Testing story:
  - Specs validate our branching/business logic
  - Mocks { ... } enables deterministic CI-safe tests
  - Real training/evaluation is opt-in (usually not part of CI)
- Dependencies:
  - core install: pip install tactus
  - training extras: pip install tactus[ml]
  - HF extras: pip install tactus[hf]

Canonical source-of-truth docs live in this repo:
- docs/MODEL_PRIMITIVE.md
- docs/model-training-walkthrough.md
- docs/MODEL_PRIMITIVE_STATUS.md

## Plan (do in this order)

1) Research + drift inventory
- In each repo, find every snippet and paragraph that describes Models and the train/eval workflow.
- Record findings as NOTES on the corresponding child bead: exact file path + what is stale + what to replace it with.

2) Holistic outline
- Decide what each property should cover at its level (web conceptual vs examples runnable vs tutorial guided vs quick ref vs deep ref).
- Identify where we should link across properties (web -> examples -> books; books -> walkthrough).

3) Draft edits
- Update content repo-by-repo using the canon snippet pack and terminology.
- Ensure code snippets correspond to runnable examples (no undefined names, no obsolete CLI).

4) QA pass
- Build the Quarto books (Learning / Nutshell / Programming).
- Run Tactus-examples test script(s) in mock mode.
- Sanity-check a real train + evaluate run for at least one example (optional but recommended).

## Definition of Done

- All properties agree on syntax/terminology/workflows.
- Examples include at least one real trainable model with meaningful mocks-based specs.
- Cross-links exist where appropriate and do not contradict the canonical behavior.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Completed cross-repo drift inventory; current Model primitive docs across web/examples/books appear coherent and aligned with canon. Epic retained as a repeatable plan template for future drift sweeps.
